verdict.rationale: First-party transparency documentation describes a Copilot Voice mode: users speak prompts in natural language and receive audio responses (copilot-docs-29). Voice-mode conversations also produce transcripts with hyperlinked citations (copilot-docs-28). This covers the core of a spoken conversation with the assistant. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of real-time, low-latency or interruptible back-and-forth, detail on platform availability for voice, and independent or hands-on corroboration of voice quality.
